title: Complete input-copying run
statement: For every Boolean word $x$, after exactly $2|x|+2$ steps from the input copier’s initial configuration on $x$, the machine is in its return control with $x$ on its work tape, both heads at their initial positions, and empty output.
replaced: For every input word $x$, running the input copier from its native initial configuration for $2|x| + 2$ steps reaches the configuration assembled from words in which the single work tape holds exactly $x$, both heads are restored, and the physical output is empty.
